must_mention.point: The enterprise profile is mandatory, so it is a floor nobody below can loosen, while a recommended profile is only a default a lower level may replace
Network and MCP access are separate allowlists: the package registry and the PayGate sandbox go in the host list and the MCP list stays empty until a server is approved
A session already running keeps the profile it resolved until it wakes or reboots, while new sessions get the change straight away
Child sessions are governed by their parent's chain, so delegating work cannot step outside the floor
Write paths are closed in the profile itself: GitHub CLI token removed, git access level, and Devin MCP read-only for automations
